evidence.computation: Specialist catalogue: arithmetic or weighted mean, median, complete tied modes, range, population/sample variance and standard deviation, combinations/permutations, binomial probability, and z-score. The reply kind selects the operation; this declaration is not a per-answer interpretation proof.
assumptions: Dataset operations use finite rational observations; sample variance/deviation need at least two observations. Population and sample denominators differ.
For weighted_mean only: equally long lists, nonnegative weights with positive sum; zero individual weights allowed. Mean is sum(value times weight) / sum(weights).
Combinatorial operations use bounded natural counts; binomial probability requires a valid trial count and probability in [0,1]; z-score requires positive standard deviation.
Exact rational calculations are formatted to four decimal places; standard deviation uses a checked square-root interval.
untrusted: English operation recognition, dataset extraction, decimal parsing and JSON framing; this catalogue does not certify that the recognized request matches the question.
